# packs/ — shareable form packs (Phase 3)

Form packs (the Four-Part conflict spine, kishōtenketsu, the Eddy, the
Prosecution) land here in the Phase-3 waves. Packs are SHAREABLE: no private
voice rule, no project data, and never a calibration passage — any file here
carrying the calibration-passage marker (the exact uppercase string exported
as `CALIBRATION_MARKER` in `lib/privacy.mjs`) fails the privacy scan test,
which names the file. Voice profiles and calibration passages live in the
writing project roots and profiles/ (gitignored), never in a pack.
